en: The Thousand-Armed Krodha-Kuṇḍalī Mantra in Sanskrit script is as follows: Oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ svāhā.
The Thousand-Armed Krodha-Kuṇḍalī Mantra is stated as: [Symbol] Āṃ hrīḥ triṃ khaṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā. Āṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ svāhā. Va.
